scenes.say: Your moh-ka pot is done sooner.
The last drop is the mistake. That stream is bitter.

scenes.title: The sputter.
scenes.say: It means the good coffee is gone.

scenes.title: Heat lingers.
scenes.say: A hot pot keeps brewing. Cool the base.

scenes.title: How to stop.
scenes.say: Low heat. Watch the stream. Pull at the first sputter.

scenes.title: The tip.
scenes.say: Hear sputtering? You're a few seconds late.
Stop at the first sputter. Send this to a moh-ka friend.
